author: phodgson
message: I think what's missing is the specialist skill/mindset for exploratory manual testing which a good QA brings to the table. A really good QA is a bug magnet. They intuitively know how to use software in just the right way to make it break. A team can get by without that skill, but they'll be missing something. It's like not having someone on the team with a good eye for UX/design. You can get by, but you'd rather not. Doesn't have to be a full-time role, but not having someone playing that role on the team leaves a hole.
